metric_definitions.paired_directional_robustness: Fraction of matched (trap, control) pairs (denominator = 2,815 on full v1.1) where BOTH predictions are simultaneously correct.
metric_definitions.trap_accuracy: Fraction of multi-study discordant fragility traps correctly abstained as 'indeterminate'.
metric_definitions.trap_overclaim_rate: Fraction of fragility traps where the model falsely claims 'upregulated' or 'downregulated'.
metric_definitions.control_accuracy: Fraction of multi-study concordant controls assigned the verified directional sign.
metric_definitions.control_abstention_rate: Fraction of concordant controls abstained as 'indeterminate' (tracks blanket abstention collapse).

epistemic_caution_rules.rule: Never assert a single organism::tissue directional gene change from a single spaceflight study when multiple clean NASA OSDR studies exist for that context without checking cross-study sign concordance.
Return 'indeterminate' (not determinable / contradictory evidence) whenever FDR q < 0.05 contrasts across independent clean OSD studies disagree in sign.

Verify contrast orientation ((Space Flight)v(Ground Control) vs inverted (GC)v(SF)) and exclude confounded compound-factor contrasts (e.g., 1G centrifugation or unequal durations) before directional synthesis.
Avoid blanket abstention: distinguish genuine cross-study discordance from missing tool retrieval by querying verified OSD differential expression tables when available.
Do not extrapolate short-duration LEO murine/model-organism transcriptomic changes directly to multi-year human deep-space pathology without explicit epistemic boundaries.
Never fabricate NASA OSDR accession numbers (OSD-###), log2FC values, or adjusted p-values (q-values).

planned_v1_2_diagnostic.framework: Scale-invariant natural-log viscoelastic trajectory diagnostic (ln[S(t)/S_0]) for low-replicate (n=5) directional instability.
